```{r loading_libraries, echo= FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyverse)
library(magrittr)
library(data.table)
library(Biostrings)
library(FcircSEC)
library(ggvenn)
library(ggpubr)
library(here)
```

merging all CIRI files

```{r merging_files, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
all_circs <- do.call(rbind,
          lapply(list.files(path = here('ciri_res'), pattern = 'circ.txt$', full.names = T), fread)) %>%
  dplyr::select(c(1:4,9:11)) %>%
  distinct(circRNA_ID, .keep_all = T)

fwrite(all_circs, here('circs_list','all_hb_and_GBM_circs.tsv'), sep = '\t')

all_circs %>% 
  dplyr::select(2:4,7) %>%
  fwrite(here('circ_seqs', 'GBM_and_brain_all.bed'), sep = '\t', col.names = F)

hb_circs <- do.call(rbind,
          lapply(list.files(path = here('ciri_res'), pattern = 'circ.txt$', full.names = T)[1:18], fread)) %>%
  dplyr::select(c(1:4,9)) %>%
  distinct(circRNA_ID, .keep_all = T) %>%
  mutate(dataset = 'healthy brain control')

gbm_prim_circs <- do.call(rbind,
          lapply(list.files(path = here('ciri_res'), pattern = 'circ.txt$', full.names = T)[19:41], fread)) %>%
  dplyr::select(c(1:4,9)) %>%
  distinct(circRNA_ID, .keep_all = T) %>%
  mutate(dataset = 'GBM primary')

fwrite(gbm_prim_circs, here('circs_list','GBM_prim_circs.tsv'), sep = '\t')

gbm_rec_circs <- do.call(rbind,
          lapply(list.files(path = here('ciri_res'), pattern = 'circ.txt$', full.names = T)[42:44], fread)) %>%
  dplyr::select(c(1:4,9)) %>%
  distinct(circRNA_ID, .keep_all = T) %>%
  mutate(dataset = 'GBM recurrent')

fwrite(gbm_rec_circs, here('circs_list','GBM_rec_circs.tsv'), sep = '\t')
```

extracting circRNA sequences (FCircSEC can be written in slightly more convenient way)

```{r extract_seqs, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
system('wget ftp://ftp.ebi.ac.uk/pub/databases/gencode/Gencode_human/release_30/GRCh37_mapping/GRCh37.primary_assembly.genome.fa.gz')
system('wget ftp://ftp.ebi.ac.uk/pub/databases/gencode/Gencode_human/release_30/GRCh37_mapping/gencode_v30lift37.gtf.gz')
system('pigz -d *.gz')
system(paste0('mv ',here(),'/GRCh37.primary_assembly.genome.fa ',here(),'/gencode_v30lift37.gtf ',here(), '/circ_seqs'))

#transcriptExtract(here('circ_seqs','gencode_v30lift37.gtf'), 'other', 'transcriptdata.txt') # run this line only once, it takes long time
#fread(here('circ_seqs','transcriptdata.txt')) %>%
  #fwrite(here('circ_seqs','transcript_data.txt'), sep = '\t', quote = T)
fread(here('circ_seqs', 'GBM_and_brain_all.bed')) %>%
  fwrite(here('circ_seqs','GBM_and_brain_all_quoted.bed'), sep = '\t', quote = T, col.names = F)
circClassification(here('circ_seqs','transcript_data.txt'), here('circ_seqs','GBM_and_brain_all_quoted.bed'),here('circ_seqs','GBM_and_brain_all_class.txt'), here('circ_seqs','GBM_and_brain_all_class.bed'))      
get.fasta(here('circ_seqs','GRCh37.primary_assembly.genome.fa'), here('circ_seqs','GBM_and_brain_all_class.bed'), here('circ_seqs','GBM_and_brain_all_genomic_seq.fa'))
circSeqExt(here('circ_seqs','GBM_and_brain_all_genomic_seq.fa'), here('circ_seqs','GBM_and_brain_all_class.txt'), here('circ_seqs','GBM_and_brain_all.fa'))
```

venn diagram (Fig 1e)

```{r venn, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
venn_diag <- ggvenn(data = list(GBM_primary = gbm_prim_circs$circRNA_ID, GBM_recurrent = gbm_rec_circs$circRNA_ID, Healthy_brain = hb_circs$circRNA_ID),
                    show_percentage = F)
pdf(here('Fig1','1e.pdf'))
venn_diag
dev.off()
```

bar plot circ types (Fig 1f)

```{r circ_types, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
circ_types_df <- rbind(hb_circs, gbm_prim_circs, gbm_rec_circs) %>%
  mutate(dataset = factor(dataset, levels = c('healthy brain control','GBM primary','GBM recurrent')),
         circRNA_type = factor(circRNA_type, levels = c('exon','intron','intergenic_region')))

bar_plt <- ggplot(data = circ_types_df, aes(x = dataset, color = circRNA_type, fill = circRNA_type))+
  geom_bar(stat="count", width=0.8)+
  labs(y="Number of circRNA")+
  theme_bw()+
  theme(axis.text.x=element_text(size=16)) +
  theme(axis.text.y=element_text(size=16)) +
  theme(axis.text.x=element_text(size=16, angle = 45, vjust = 1, hjust = 1)) +
  theme(axis.title.y=element_text(size=20)) +
  theme(legend.text=element_text(size=18)) +
  theme(legend.title=element_text(size=20)) +
  guides(color = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 3)))+
  rremove('xlab')

pdf((here('Fig1','1f.pdf')))
bar_plt
dev.off()
```

length (Fig 1g-i)

```{r length, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
all_circs_length <- readDNAStringSet(here('circ_seqs','GBM_and_brain_all.fa')) %>%
  lapply(., length) %>%
  unlist() %>%
  enframe() %>%
  dplyr::rename(c('ID'='name','length'='value')) %>%
  mutate(ID = gsub('-','|',ID))
hb_len <- all_circs_length %>%
  filter(ID%in%hb_circs$circRNA_ID)
prim_len <- all_circs_length %>%
  filter(ID%in%gbm_prim_circs$circRNA_ID)
rec_len <- all_circs_length %>%
  filter(ID%in%gbm_rec_circs$circRNA_ID)

hb_len_hist <- ggplot(data = hb_len, aes(x = length))+
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 50, 
                 col="black", 
                 fill="blue", 
                 alpha = .2)+ 
  ggtitle("healthy brain control")+
  labs(x="Spliced length", y="Number of circRNA")+
  theme_bw()+
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust=0.5, size = 20))+
  theme(axis.text.x=element_text(size=16)) +
  theme(axis.text.y=element_text(size=16)) +
  theme(axis.title.x=element_text(size=20)) +
  theme(axis.title.y=element_text(size=20)) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim=c(1,5000))+
  geom_vline(xintercept = median(hb_len$length),
             col = "red",
             lwd = .2,
             linetype = 'dashed')

prim_len_hist <- ggplot(data = prim_len, aes(x = length))+
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 50, 
                 col="black", 
                 fill="blue", 
                 alpha = .2)+ 
  ggtitle("GBM primary")+
  labs(x="Spliced length", y="Number of circRNA")+
  theme_bw()+
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust=0.5, size = 20))+
  theme(axis.text.x=element_text(size=16)) +
  theme(axis.text.y=element_text(size=16)) +
  theme(axis.title.x=element_text(size=20)) +
  theme(axis.title.y=element_text(size=20)) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim=c(1,5000))+
  geom_vline(xintercept = median(prim_len$length),
             col = "red",
             lwd = .2,
             linetype = 'dashed')

rec_len_hist <- ggplot(data = rec_len, aes(x = length))+
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 50, 
                 col="black", 
                 fill="blue", 
                 alpha = .2)+ 
  ggtitle("GBM recurrent")+
  labs(x="Spliced length", y="Number of circRNA")+
  theme_bw()+
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust=0.5, size = 20))+
  theme(axis.text.x=element_text(size=16)) +
  theme(axis.text.y=element_text(size=16)) +
  theme(axis.title.x=element_text(size=20)) +
  theme(axis.title.y=element_text(size=20)) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim=c(1,5000))+
  geom_vline(xintercept = median(rec_len$length),
             col = "red",
             lwd = .2,
             linetype = 'dashed')

pdf((here('Fig1','1g.pdf')))
hb_len_hist
dev.off()

pdf((here('Fig1','1h.pdf')))
prim_len_hist
dev.off()

pdf((here('Fig1','1i.pdf')))
rec_len_hist
dev.off()
```
